title: Veneto 5 m DTM -> 4033 Landscape candidate
hypothesis: A 4033 x 4033 Landscape prepared from the official Veneto 5 m DTM is sufficient for rider-visible Passo Giau terrain.
technical: 33 tiles produced a 1600 x 1600 native 5 m working grid.
The isolated 4033 x 4033 Landscape authored successfully with 1024 components.
Route truth and L_CyclingTest remained unchanged.
visual: Macro terrain is real and correctly scaled, but steep camera-close faces expose visible heightfield stepping/ribbing.
The Landscape grid is not accepted as final foreground terrain from the rider camera.
keep: Veneto 5 m DTM as the macro-terrain source.
Isolated Passo Giau map and deterministic authoring path.
Landscape for broad continuous terrain away from inspectable steep faces.
reject: One uniform Landscape heightfield as the only representation for camera-close steep Dolomite terrain.
learnings: Increasing the UE raster density does not invent source detail.
Foreground steep surfaces need a different representation or a higher-detail local corridor.
next: Separate macro Landscape responsibility from rider-visible meso/road-corridor geometry.
